meta.description: Optional seed cases so the staff queue is populated after a reset. CASE-1042 and CASE-SEC-1 are copied unchanged from contracts/demo_fixture_v1.json. These are example triage outputs, not answers for the intake agent: live intake must interpret each request with the model.

cases.original_words: I need six thousand dollars from the Roth thing from my old job.
cases.confirmed_plain_language_request: I want to speak with an advisor about using $6,000 from my retirement account from my former employer.
cases.staff_summary: Client requests discussion of a possible $6,000 distribution from a rollover IRA for care expenses.
unresolved_questions: Potential tax implications for advisor review

cases.original_words: I don't recognize a sign-in alert on my account.
cases.confirmed_plain_language_request: I need help reviewing an account sign-in I do not recognize.
cases.staff_summary: Client reports a possible unauthorized sign-in and requests account-access review.
unresolved_questions: Time and device of the alert

cases.original_words: Can I put more money into my Roth IRA this year?
cases.confirmed_plain_language_request: I want to ask an advisor whether I can add more money to my Roth retirement account this year.
cases.staff_summary: Client asks about making an additional current-year contribution to a Roth IRA.
unresolved_questions: How much the client wants to add

cases.original_words: I want my daughter to be the one who gets my retirement account if something happens to me.
cases.confirmed_plain_language_request: I want to talk with someone about updating who receives my retirement account if I pass away.
cases.staff_summary: Client requests review of the beneficiary designation on a traditional IRA.
unresolved_questions: Whether the client also wants to review the joint account
